title: Climate zones of Europe
intro: Name the Koppen-Geiger climate class of each city in Europe. The class is read from a 1 km map for the city's location.

questions.prompt: Which Koppen-Geiger climate class does Turin, Italy have?
choices: Cfc: Temperate, no dry season, cold summer
BSk: Arid, steppe, cold
Cfa: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer
Dfa: Cold, no dry season, hot summer
questions.explain: On the Beck et al. 1980-2016 map, Turin lies in class Cfa: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer.
